CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(Billing_Method__c) = "Membership Billing", IF( Bill_to_Self__c, FirstName & " " & LastName, IF( Bill_to_Group__c, Advisor_Group__r.Name, Bill_To__r.FirstName & " " & Bill_To__r.LastName ) ), Advisor_Group__r.Name )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: - If Billing Method is Membership Billing AND Bill to self is TRUE: Account Name - If Billing Method is Membership Billing AND Bill to Group is TRUE: Advisor Group Name - If Billing Method is Membership Billing AND Bill to self & group are FALSE: Bill To - Everything else: Advisor Group Name
CustomField.label: Customer-Advisor Name
